slides.texte_overlay:
7 ways to be unrecognisable
in 6 months
Learn to cook ten real meals. One new recipe every two weeks. In six months you eat better, spend less, and you can host anyone at home with real confidence.
Change your wardrobe slowly. Replace one worn-out piece each month with something that fits well. Six months later, you look sharper without spending a fortune.
Walk ten thousand steps a day. No gym needed to start. Daily walking changes your energy, your mood and your body more than people ever expect from something so simple.
Read and learn every day. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and six months of tiny lessons turns you into a completely different person to talk to.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Six months of tiny lessons makes you a different person to talk to.

slides.texte_overlay: Say yes to one new thing a month. A class, a trip, an event alone. New experiences change you faster than anything else, and they make great stories to tell too.
Fix your posture every day. Two minutes against a wall each morning. By month six, you stand taller, look more confident and feel much better in your own body.
Stop complaining for a whole month, then keep going. Notice every complaint and replace it with a solution. Your mindset will be unrecognisable before your body is.
